listed.name: Rías Baixas
listed.why: Its rules take some of its municipios only in part, so drawing them whole would claim ground that is not its own.

listed.name: Amandi
listed.why: Its pliego takes the parroquia of Anllo only for its lugares in the Sil basin, and Anllo is more than a tenth of its ground, so its whole parroquias would leave too much out.
